problem:
Evaluate the mixed integral

$$
{∬}_{D}[{\int }_{0}^{y}12z\,\text{d}x]\text{d}A
$$

where the region $D$ in the $yz$-plane is given by

$$
D={(y,z)\,:\,0\le y\le 2,\,0\le z\le 4-{y}^{2}}.
$$
worked_solution:
First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $x,$ treating $y$ and $z$ as constants:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}[{\int }_{0}^{y}12z\,\text{d}x]\text{d}A & ={∬}_{D}12z[x]_{x=0}^{x=y}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}12z(y-0)\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}12yz\,\text{d}A\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the double integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}yz\,\text{d}A & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{4-{y}^{2}}12yz\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}6y[{z}^{2}]_{z=0}^{z=4-{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}6y(4-{y}^{2})^{2}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}(96y-48{y}^{3}+6{y}^{5})\,\text{d}y \\  & ={[48{y}^{2}-12{y}^{4}+{y}^{6}]}_{y=0}^{y=2} \\  & =48(2)^{2}-12(2)^{4}+(2)^{6} \\  & =64\end{aligned}
$$
